entities.summary: Nyeleti Brooke Mondlane is a politician in Mozambique. She is the daughter of FRELIMO President Eduardo Mondlane and American-born activist and politician Janet Mondlane. Nyeleti Mondlane was a architects & engineers from Syracuse (b. 1962-01-17, Syracuse). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
